answer: A tundra trading post stays honest when every new identity must descend a distinct glacier crevasse on foot, unspooling rope in arm-lengths while a distinct surveyor stamps each length at the wharf gate. The first fake owes one rope-length, the second two, the third three, the fifth eight, since the nth fake owes the next Fibonacci number, so the tenth fake alone owes eighty-nine rope-lengths and twenty fakes owe 28,655. Bulk farming fails because one climber descends one crevasse at a time, each rope knotted to one crevasse, like one shepherd crossing one meadow per dawn.
